Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. They always ask why I didn’t make more | full recipe ⬇️ Smoked to perfection with @harmosgrill flavored pellets Serves: 6–8  Total Time: ~2–3 hours (including marinade) Ingredients Chicken 3–4 lbs bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs (non-negotiable) 3–4 tbsp spicy brown mustard 2 tbsp Cuso’s Hot Honey Seasoning 2 tbsp Cuso’s Roasted Garlic & Onion Seasoning Grill / Smoke Harmos wood pellets: Spanish Barbecue Pirate & Turkish Barbecue Traveler Jalapeño Green Sauce 2–3 jalapeños (adjust for heat) 1 cup fresh cilantro 2–3 garlic cloves ½ cup Greek yogurt 2–3 tbsp olive oil Salt, to taste Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Marinate the Chicken Add chicken thighs to a large bowl. Coat fully with spicy brown mustard. Season generously with Cuso’s Hot Honey + Roasted Garlic & Onion seasoning. Mix until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least a few hours (overnight preferred). 2. Preheat the Grill Preheat your pellet grill to 350°F. Load with Harmos pellets (Spanish Barbecue Pirate + Turkish Barbecue Traveler) for deep smoky flavor with paprika, garlic, rosemary, and spice notes. 3. Make the Jalapeño Green Sauce Add jalapeños, cilantro, garlic, Greek yogurt, olive oil, salt, and pepper to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning or heat. Chill until ready to serve. 4. Smoke the Chicken Place chicken directly on the grill grates. Cook for about 1 hour, until internal temp reaches 160°F. 5. Crank the Heat Increase grill temp to 500°F. Medicube... what is really going on? Medicube Sudan Red dye scandal. On 24th July 2026, Hong Kong Customs issued a warning to consumers to stop using Medicube's PDRN Pink Collagen Capsule Cream after its government laboratory detected Sudan Red, a banned carcinogenic industrial dye. Medicube has responded by releasing an independent South Korean lab (Intertek) report showing that Sudan Red was 'Not Detected’ The investigation is still ongoing and we do not have all of the information to make definitive conclusions yet. This is not the first time Medicube have been under question due to possible Sudan Red contamination. In late 2025, there was a massive recall of certain red-tinted skincare products in China and Taiwan due to Sudan Red dye contamination traced back to raw material suppliers. Medicube denied being affected by this however they introduced a new formulation in March 2026 for their PDRN pink collagen capsule cream. As skincare consumers, we often assume that products on the shelves are safe. Cases like this are a reminder of why independent third-party testing plays such a vital role in protecting consumer safety. @oneeyebeauty_official 's website has a useful guide for spotting fake products online

videos.caption: Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Cherry blossoms are among the most beautiful and admired flowers in the world. Known for their soft pink and white petals, these delicate blooms appear during the spring season and symbolize renewal, hope, beauty, and the short but meaningful nature of life. Cherry blossom trees, often called sakura in Japan, have become deeply connected to culture, art, poetry, and traditions across many countries. Every year, millions of people gather in parks, gardens, and streets to witness the brief but breathtaking blooming season that transforms landscapes into seas of pink and white. Cherry blossoms bloom for only a short period, usually lasting one to two weeks depending on weather conditions. This short life span is one reason they are so admired. Their beauty reminds people that life itself is temporary and precious. In Japanese culture, cherry blossoms represent the idea of living in the moment and appreciating beauty while it lasts. Festivals called hanami, meaning “flower viewing,” are held during the blooming season. Families and friends gather beneath the trees for picnics, music, laughter, and celebration while enjoying the falling petals drifting through the air like soft pink snow. The history of cherry blossoms dates back thousands of years. In ancient Japan, emperors and nobles admired the blossoms and wrote poetry inspired by them. Over time, the tradition spread throughout society and eventually became known around the world. Today, cherry blossom festivals are celebrated in many countries including the United States, South Korea, and China. One of the most famous celebrations outside Japan takes place in Washington, D.C., where thousands of cherry blossom trees bloom around the Tidal Basin each spring. These trees were gifted by Japan in 1912 as a symbol of friendship between nations.#fyp #fyp #fypシ゚viral #foryou #japan

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

Most addictive snack in Italy 🇮🇹 Taralli are everywhere in Puglia, from restaurants and markets to gas stations. Made with just 4 ingredients, they’re crunchy and dangerously easy to eat. No table is complete without a basket of taralli and a bottle of wine🍷 INGREDIENTS 1000g 00 flour 360g dry white wine 220g extra virgin olive oil 20g sea salt Makes about 100 taralli. For different flavors, add fennel seeds, black pepper, rosemary, or chili flakes to the dough. DIRECTIONS 1. Add flour to a bowl and make a well. Mix wine, olive oil, and salt, pour into the center, and gradually incorporate the flour. 2. Knead for about 10 minutes until smooth, then rest for 10 minutes. 3. Roll small pieces into thin ropes and join the ends to form rings. 4. Boil in batches for about 1 minute, then drain on a clean cloth. 5. Transfer to a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25–30 minutes, until golden and crispy. #italianfood #easyrecipe #fy

This Banana Omelet Tastes Like French Toast 🍳 🍌 ⸻ Ingredients ▶️ 1 ripe banana (120 g) ▶️ 2 large eggs ▶️ 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon ▶️ 1/2 tsp vanilla powder ▶️ Small pinch of sea salt ▶️ 1 tsp butter or extra-virgin olive oil (for the pan) ⸻ Preparation 1. Peel the banana and mash it in a bowl until mostly smooth. 2. Add the eggs, cinnamon, vanilla powder, and sea salt. 3. Whisk until well combined. 4. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat and lightly grease it with the butter or olive oil. 5. Pour the mixture into the skillet and spread it into an even circle. 6. Cook for 3–4 minutes, until the bottom is golden and the top is mostly set. 7. Carefully flip the omelet with a wide spatula and cook for another 2–3 minutes, until fully cooked through. 8. Fold the omelet in half and serve warm. ⸻ Tips (For Best Results) 💡 Use a ripe banana: The riper the banana, the sweeter and more French toast-like the flavor. 💡 Cook over medium-low heat: This allows the eggs to cook through without burning the banana. 💡 Mash the banana well: A smoother mixture creates a more even texture. 💡 Use a non-stick skillet: It makes flipping much easier. 💡 Flip gently: Wait until the omelet is mostly set before turning it over. 💡 Customize the toppings: Serve with fresh berries, Greek yogurt, chopped nuts, or a drizzle of honey. 💡 Enjoy immediately: The texture is best while warm. ⸻ Nutrition (1 omelet) ✅ Calories: ~260 kcal ✅ Protein: ~14 g ✅ Carbs: ~25 g ✅ Fat: ~11 g ✅ Fiber: ~3 g #bananaomelet #healthybreakfast #highproteinbreakfast #healthyfood #recipe

Ingredients: 2-3 Ibs boneless skinless chicken thighs 2 tbsp low sodium soy sauce 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp onion powder 2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Sauce* 2 tbsp butter 1/2 cup low sodium soy sauce 1/2 cup hoisin sauce 1/4 cup bourbon or apple juice 1/4 cup brown sugar 1 tsp ginger paste or 2 tsp of ginger powder  1 tbsp garlic paste or 2 tbsp of garlic powder  1/4 tsp red pepper flakes 1/4 tsp browning (for color)  Instructions 1.) Season your chicken with soy sauce, garlic powder, onion powder and all-purpose seasoning. In pan on medium heat, add oil & cook chicken on each side for about 7-8 minutes then remove. Dice chicken to your liking.  2.) In the same pan, add in butter, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, hoisin sauce, bourbon/apple juice, brown sugar, red pepper flakes and browning.  3.) Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! VIRAL CARROT WRAPS 🥕 I’ve made a vacation of these with zucchini, pickles, jalapeños, and I had to put a spin on them with carrots. These are probably my second favorite after the zucchini, they come out really good, super pliable/ and they are a touch sweeter which went really well with the toppings I used here. A medium carrot has about 4 net carbs, so this is a great lower carb option if you’re watching carbs. Recipe makes 3-4 wraps Here is how I made it: 1.Preheat oven to 375F.  2.Shred 3 medium carrots into a bowl. Crack in an egg, add 1 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese, toss in 1/2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp chipotle pepper (optional), and a small pinch of salt. Mix really well. 3.Grab a cookie sheet, line with parchment paper (important!) and scoop the carrot mixture into circular shapes. You’ll get 3-4 good sized wraps here. 4.Pop it into the oven at 375F for 16-18 minutes. Then remove and let cool for a few minutes while you prep your fillings 5.I spread a base of my homemade guac here. Just mash 2 avocados with the juice of 1 lime, a large handful of freshly chopped cilantro, 1/2 small white onion, a couple pinches of salt, and about a tablespoon of toasted sesame seeds for crunch (optional).  6.I also added some leftover shredded beef (chicken or shrimp work just fine), topped with a tsp of sour cream, some sriracha, and more fresh cilantro. Again, use what you like here! 7.Plate them up and devour. If you make these, be sure to let me know on SHREDHAPPENS - these are a great lowcarb wrap or lower crab bread option, and a great way to sneak in some extra veggies. ENJOY! . . . . #lowcarb #lowcarbrecipes #healthyrecipe #goodmoodfood #healthyfoodshare #whatsonmyplate

Valentine’s Day Dinner - Ep. 2: Spicy Vodka Chicken Parm Pasta 🔥❤️ recipe ⬇️ 1 large chicken breast, butterflied and pounded thin 2 eggs 2 cups seasoned breadcrumbs or use panko and season with salt, Italian seasoning, garlic & onion powder  1/4 cup parmesan cheese, freshly grated Slice chicken breasts in half. Place in a ziplock bag or plastic wrap. Pound with anything heavy until super thin. Dip in egg and then in seasoned breadcrumbs/panko. Press down so the breading sticks. Thoroughly spray with oil and air fry 380F for 10 min. Immediately sprinkle salt over fried chicken. Top with vodka sauce ⬇️ and slices of mozzarella. 🌌🍫 Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake 🍫🌌 Ingredients: For the chocolate cake: 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour 2 cups (400 g) granulated sugar ¾ cup (75 g) unsweetened cocoa powder 2 teaspoons baking powder 1½ teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk, room temperature ½ cup (120 ml) vegetable oil 2 large eggs, room temperature 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 cup (240 ml) hot coffee (or hot water) For the chocolate ganache filling: 1½ cups (270 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream 2 tablespoons butter For the galaxy mirror glaze: 1 tablespoon gelatin powder ¼ cup (60 ml) cold water 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar ⅔ cup (160 ml) sweetened condensed milk ½ cup (120 ml) water 1½ cups (270 g) white chocolate, chopped Gel food coloring (blue, purple, black, and pink) Edible glitter or luster dust (optional for stars ✨) Directions: Make the cake layers: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line three 8-inch round pans with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add buttermilk, oil, eggs, and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Gradually stir in hot coffee (batter will be thin). Divide evenly into pans and bake for 25–30 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely before assembling. Prepare the ganache filling: Heat heavy cream in a saucepan until just simmering. Pour over chocolate chips and butter in a bowl. Let sit for 3 minutes, then whisk until smooth and glossy. Allow to cool slightly before using. Assemble the cake: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread a layer of ganache. Repeat with the second and third layers. Smooth the outside with ganache for a clean surface. Refrigerate for 1 hour to set. Prepare the galaxy mirror glaze: Sprinkle gelatin over ¼ cup cold water and let bloom for 10 minutes. In a saucepan, combine sugar, sweetened condensed milk, and ½ cup water. Bring to a gentle boil, then remove from heat. Add bloomed gelatin and stir until fully dissolved. Pour over chopped white chocolate and let sit for 5 minutes. Blend with an immersion blender until smooth (avoid bubbles). Divide the glaze into separate bowls and tint with food colors (blue, purple, black, and pink). Let the glaze cool to about 90°F (32°C). Create the galaxy effect: Pour the colored glazes into one large bowl in swirls (don’t mix). Pour the glaze over the chilled cake from the center outward, letting the colors blend naturally. Add edible glitter or luster dust for a starry galaxy look. Finish and serve: Let the glaze drip and set for 10–15 minutes. Slice and serve your stunning Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake! Nutritional Information (per slice): ⏰ Prep Time: 1 hour | Baking Time: 30 minutes | Chill Time: 2 hours | Total Time: ~3½ hours 🔥 Kcal: ~520 kcal per slice 🍽️ Servings: 12 This Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake is as mesmerizing as it is delicious — rich chocolate layers filled with creamy ganache and topped with a cosmic swirl of glossy glaze. Divide the ground beef into 6 equal portions. 4. Season the beef lightly with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. 5. Place one tortilla on a hot skillet or griddle. 6. Press one portion of ground beef directly onto the tortilla, spreading it into a thin, even layer almost to the edges. 7. Cook beef-side down for 2–3 minutes until deeply browned and crispy. 8. Flip the tortilla and beef together, then immediately place a slice of cheddar cheese on top. 9. Cook for another 1–2 minutes until the tortilla is crisp and the cheese is melted. 10. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and beef. 11. Top each taco with shredded lettuce, diced onion, and diced tomatoes. 12. Drizzle generously with the creamy burger sauce. 13. Fold the tacos slightly and serve immediately while the beef is hot and the cheese is melted. 14. Add extra pickles or sauce if desired for an even more classic burger flavor. How to build an AI employee that works while you sleep. An AI agent is just a loop (goal → step → check → repeat) that can reach for tools. On its own it hits a wall: it forgets everything, waits for you, owns nothing. The ladder that turns it into staff: • ① context — files YOU write; it reads them every run so nothing's generic, and they grow (you're raising it) • ② memory — facts + your rules + how-to's; a skill is a memory • ③ a lane, not a task • ④ tools — MCP, ~1 min to connect • ⑤ a schedule — wakes on its own, pings you only for decisions • ⑥ guardrails — low-stakes it does; high-stakes it drafts and waits for your yes I run mine from a Google Sheet — it drafts every reply in my voice, I approve in 10 minutes, every 30 minutes it sends the approved ones and learns from my revisions. The moat: anyone can buy the same AI. Nobody has your context. Come build it with me. #aiemployee #aiagent #aiautomation #professorglitch

Replying to @naomi when pricing my pieces I consider time spent making/decorating/signing/waxing/glazing/sanding/lustering/firing/invetorying. I have done time studies to help gauge the time I spend on making the pieces. I also consider materials used. I apply gold luster to almost every piece and it’s expensive and requires an additional firing which is also another expense. I also consider experience. I have been working with clay for 14 years now so I consider all of those years of working to this point in my pieces value as well. Pricing is hard! Placing a value on your art is uncomfortable. I’m just happy to be here and I’m doing my best with the knowledge I have gained so far on this journey. I don’t think there is a right answer that will work for everyone, I’m just trying to do what feels right to me! 30-Minute Beef Bulgogi Bowls 🥩🍚🥒🥢 If you’re looking for an easy 30-minute dinner, these Beef Bulgogi Bowls are it! While the beef marinates, prep your cucumber salad and get your rice going. Once everything is prepped, the beef only takes a few minutes to cook, making this such an easy dinner to whip up on a busy night!  Ingredients: For the Beef Bulgogi: • 24 oz ribeye, thinly sliced • ⅓ cup soy sauce • 1 tbsp mirin • 2 tbsp brown sugar • 1 tbsp honey • 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tsp fresh ginger, grated • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ yellow onion, thinly sliced • 2 green onions, sliced • Neutral oil, for cooking • Sesame seeds, for garnish For the Spicy Cucumber Salad: • 1 English cucumber, thinly sliced • ½ tsp salt • 1 tbsp gochujang • 1 tbsp rice vinegar • 1 tsp soy sauce • 1 tsp sugar • 1 tsp toasted sesame oil • 1 garlic clove, minced • 1 tsp sesame seeds For serving: • Steamed white rice Directions: 1. Mix the soy sauce, mirin, brown sugar, honey, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and black pepper. Add the sliced ribeye, yellow onion, and green onions and toss until coated. Let marinate while you prep everything else. 2. Toss the sliced cucumber with salt and let sit for about 10 minutes to draw out the moisture. Drain and pat dry. 3. Mix the gochujang, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, and garlic. Toss with the cucumbers and finish with sesame seeds. 4. While the beef marinates and cucumbers sit, cook your rice. 5. Heat a large skillet or wok over high heat with a little neutral oil. Cook the beef in batches for about 2–3 minutes, tossing occasionally, until caramelized and cooked through. 6. Build your bowls with warm rice, beef bulgogi, and the spicy cucumber salad. Finish with sesame seeds and enjoy! An easy 30-minute dinner that tastes like you spent way more time on it.  #beefbulgogi #30minutemeals #mealprepideas #easyrecipes #dinnerideas
